dungeon.title: The End: the dungeon under the altar (Claude draft 1)

objects.label: The Cracked Slab
objects.notes: Who: the thing that came up out of the sand lay folded here. Proof: the altar's underside, split in two, a nest of grey cloth and chain; light falls from the crack.

objects.label: From the red desert: the cracked altar, steps down
Crawlers (small kin of the altar thing) ×2
objects.notes: weak

The Trains' Stair
objects.notes: Who: the captives, walking down alone after the escorts turned back. Proof: every step dished by bare feet and shackle-drag; 28 footprints in dust (the same number that stopped on the sand).

objects.label: Worn steps and shackle scars: nothing here is ever explained
The Hushed (sealed mouths, weeping) ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: A child's shoe, a tin whistle (small things the taken carried)

objects.label: Cairns: the missing's things; nobody owns up
Cave spiders, big ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Black Gate
objects.notes: Who: nobody knows who built it; older than records. Proof: the first black stone walls indoors, scorched on top as if burned from below; a gate of black glass, open.

objects.label: Black stone, scorched from below: first sight indoors
Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Cold Hall
objects.notes: Who: the escorts' last duty: they unchained here. Proof: a chain rail down the middle, forty open shackles, a long bench, a bell with no clapper (it is not rung).

objects.label: Wearers (grey-robed, chained) ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Hushed ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Escorts' Shelter

objects.label: Supplies: bread, oil, a healing draught
Unsent letter (book slot: a guard's letter, Noah)

objects.notes: Who: the head-counter. Proof: a desk cut into the wall, a ledger of trains by month; the last page is a column of numbers that ends.

objects.label: Book slot: head-count ledger, the last page (Noah)

The Long Fall
objects.notes: Who: the way down to the Waiting Place. Proof: a great spiral stair, the first sight of the Well's glow far below: the same light as the first dream.

objects.label: Spiral down to the Waiting Place
Looking down: the light from the first dream

objects.notes: weak

objects.label: The Well (the shaft, void)
objects.notes: Who: nobody; this is the lid. Proof: four great chains hang into the dark, one from each wing; the glow from far below is the same as the first dream. Walk only on the rim.

objects.label: Four chains: each is lifted by a wheel in a wing; the Well's lid
Spiral stair down the Well: chained shut until all four wheels are turned
The Throat's Foot
objects.notes: Who: the trains' last stop before the Well. Proof: shackle rings set into the floor, a sand-drift from above, the stair behind you.

objects.label: The Hushed ×2
objects.notes: weak

objects.label: The Hall of Listening
objects.notes: Who: whoever came to listen to the Well. Proof: a ring of worn benches facing the rim, the floor polished by knees; each wing's gate hums a different note here.

objects.label: The four notes: death, hunger, delivery, sacrifice; they sound together at the end
Offerings left on the benches: small coins, buttons
The Cot
objects.notes: Who: the last slayer, long ago, before he went down. Proof: a narrow cot, a rusted shackle on its post, a fire ring, a battered cup. A bed anyone can sleep in (suggest: dying below the Steps wakes you here).

objects.label: The Cot: sleep to rest and save (Noah to decide the death rule)
Fire ring and rusted shackle (the slayer's)
The Escorts' Lean-to
objects.notes: Who: the escorts' last depot. Proof: ration sacks, water skins, a lantern oil jar, a boot-print of every escort in the dust.

objects.label: A little food, water, oil (a small refill, not a full one)
Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Gate of the Quiet (Death)
objects.notes: Who: the dead who go through. Proof: willow-root carving round the arch; the stone's note is low and wet.

objects.label: Stairs down to the Hum Gate (Death wing)
Hold up the stone: the gate hums open
The Gate of the Lean (Hunger)
objects.notes: Who: the hungry who went through. Proof: gold-vein carving round the arch, bread-crumbs worn into the sill; the note is thin and tight.

objects.label: Stairs down to the Lean Gate (Hunger wing)

objects.label: Stairs down to the Receiving Hall (Delivery wing)

objects.label: Stairs down to the Chain Gate (Sacrifice wing)

objects.label: Names scratched: the missing from Prospect (subtitled)
The Hushed ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Escort Barracks
objects.notes: Who: the paladin escort. Proof: bunks, a rack of mail, a dice board; a half-packed saddle-bag.

objects.label: Escort dead (paladins) ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Long Walk
objects.notes: Who: every train, once. Proof: the longest hall in the dungeon, a bare track worn down the middle; 28 footprints, then 28, then 28; the belongings the taken dropped.

objects.label: Belongings along the walk: a shawl A.M., a pine horse, a tin ring (the same things found on the sand)
Hushed (they rise as you pass) ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Confessional
objects.notes: Who: those who confessed before the walk. Proof: a row of wooden booths, a grille in each, a dried flower left on a ledge.

objects.label: Wearers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: Chapel of the Sun
objects.notes: Who: the Abbey's own. Proof: a gold sun over older carving: the sun is new, the carving under it is not; stained glass cracked.

objects.label: Holy dead (the escort's priest) ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The carving under the sun: do not explain
The Vestry
objects.notes: Who: the vestry keepers. Proof: robes by the dozen, a wash-basin, a chest of candles.

objects.label: Wearers ×2
objects.notes: weak

objects.label: The Release Stair
objects.notes: Who: the way the captives went down the last time. Proof: wide stairs, an iron gate (Key A), a worn rail.

objects.label: The Cold Cells
objects.notes: Who: the ones who refused. Proof: four colder cells, cut deeper, nothing in them.

objects.label: The Hushed ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: Reliquary of Chains
objects.notes: Who: a priest of the walk. Proof: a chest, a chain of silver links, a prayer in a dead script.

objects.label: Thief relic (unique, for the Thief line)
The Release
objects.notes: Who: the place the chains came off. Proof: a pit of cast-off shackles, hundreds, rusted together.

objects.label: The shackle pit: every one was opened with a key
The Wardrobe of Grey
objects.notes: Who: the robe-keepers. Proof: rows of grey robes on hooks; some hang with the shape of someone in them.

objects.label: Wearers (the robes stand) ×6
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Last Gate
objects.notes: Who: where the trains were let through to the sand. Proof: a great sealed gate with shackle-marks up to head height; light under it.

objects.label: The Hushed ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The gate: the other side is the desert; sealed (do not explain)
The Lamentation Hall
objects.notes: Who: those who wept for the walkers. Proof: a long hall in silence; the weeping is felt, not heard (SILENCE again).

objects.label: The Hushed ×7
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: SILENCE: spells fail; the Hushed are silent too
The Counting Stones
objects.notes: Who: the stone-counters. Proof: pillars cut with tally-marks, thousands, in a pattern that stops at the last train.

objects.label: Tally pillars: the last mark is today's
Hushed ×2
objects.notes: weak

objects.label: The Hall of Pledges
objects.notes: Who: the escort's oath-takers. Proof: oaths cut into the wall in the Abbey's hand; the pledge is the same one on every row.

objects.label: Escort dead ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Cold Store
objects.notes: Who: the stewards. Proof: cold shelves, a locked box, spoiled food.

objects.label: The Hushed ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Penitents' Cells
objects.notes: Who: those who asked to walk. Proof: cells with the doors on the inside; a bell-pull that opens them.

objects.label: Hushed ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Warden's Antechamber
objects.notes: Who: the Last Escort's squire. Proof: a rack of one kind of arrow, a stand for a helm, a bell with no clapper.

objects.label: Escort dead ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: Door ahead: two locks, Key A and Key B
The Bell Room
objects.notes: Who: the bell-ringers. Proof: the bell's clapper, set on a table: its other half upstairs.

objects.label: Clapper: carry it to the silent bell (an idea: it breaks the SILENCE for a fight)
Hushed ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Grey Chapel
objects.notes: Who: the last priest. Proof: a grey altar, grey candles, one small figure kneeling.

objects.label: Wearers ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Unsent Letters
objects.notes: Who: the post-keeper. Proof: a post-box of letters the captives wrote and the Abbey held back; the rest of the Dear Annet letter.

objects.label: A lock of hair, a ring
The Hold of Things
objects.notes: Who: those who took what they carried. Proof: sacks of small things sorted, each tagged by a name.

objects.label: A big cache: the taken's small things
Hushed ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Last Escort's Hall
objects.notes: Who: the Last Escort, who never turned back. Proof: a hall sixteen cells long, a long iron rail down the middle with a chain; footprints that go one way.

objects.label: Warden of the Walk (the Last Escort: armoured, chained, its chain pulls you; silence in its reach)
objects.notes: wing mini-boss: far scarier than tough is the altar thing; these are tough

objects.label: Escort dead ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: Wheel of the Walk
objects.notes: Who: no one; the fourth chain's wheel. Proof: a black iron wheel, a chain running down into the Well, a window onto it.

objects.label: Wheel: hold up the stone and turn it; the fourth chain lifts
Rope lift up to the Waiting Place (rim)
The Well (the shaft, void)
objects.notes: All four wings look into it; four chains run down it.

objects.label: The Shaft Foot
objects.notes: Who: the last slayer, who went down. Proof: the bottom of the Well, the four chains hang to here and end in great rings; the spiral stair comes down the wall.

objects.label: Spiral stair up to the Waiting Place (long)
The four chains end in rings: lifted, the lid is open
Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Seep
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, drinking. Proof: a thin seep into a hand-cut basin, a tin cup on a nail.

objects.label: Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: weak

objects.label: The Crawl Nest
objects.notes: Who: the things that came up. Proof: a hollow where something curled; scraps of grey cloth.

objects.label: Crawlers ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Slide
objects.notes: Who: the slayer's way down. Proof: a hand-cut chute with rope grooves; scratch-marks.

objects.label: Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: Chute: a short fall, no way back up here
The Echo
objects.notes: Who: nobody; the walls carry sound. Proof: your own footsteps come back a beat behind.

objects.label: The Hushed ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The echo is wrong: it answers before you speak
The Last Dig
objects.notes: Who: the slayer's first dead end. Proof: a pick snapped off in the rock, a bedroll, tally marks to a hundred.

objects.label: Pick snapped in the rock: he turned back here
Crawlers ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Store
objects.notes: Who: the slayer's supplies. Proof: a rope coil, a dried loaf, lamp-oil jars; nothing has been taken.

objects.label: Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Bottom Tally
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, counting. Proof: a whole wall of tallies in fives, a second wall in another hand.

objects.label: Two walls of tallies: a count that is not his alone
Crawlers ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Cold Room
objects.notes: Who: no one; the air is cold. Proof: frost on the walls though nothing is cold; breath that does not fog.

objects.label: The Hushed ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Day-Marks
objects.notes: Who: the slayer. Proof: a day-count on a wall that goes up past a year, then stops.

objects.label: Crawlers ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Dry Room
objects.notes: Who: a rest he took. Proof: a bedroll, a dry ledge, a letter written and burned (the ash still holds the lines).

objects.label: Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: His Cell
objects.notes: Who: the last slayer. Proof: a cell cut by hand, a rusted shackle on the wall beside a bunk: the same kind as the shackle you woke in. Do not explain.

objects.label: The shackle on the wall: yours was the same make
Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Bedroll Hollow
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, sleeping badly. Proof: a hollow in the dirt in the shape of a man; a fire-ring; a second hollow beside it, smaller, older.

objects.label: Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The First Dig
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, starting. Proof: the first raw tunnel mouth, pick-marks, a tool-rack, a rope up to a blocked hole.

objects.label: Crawlers ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The First Tally Wall
objects.notes: Who: the slayer. Proof: tallies in fives, the first week; a name scratched out beside them.

objects.label: A name scratched out: do not answer whose
Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Seam
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, digging. Proof: where he struck the black stone and kept going; a vein of it in the wall that glitters.

objects.label: Crawlers ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The seam: black stone, scorched from below
The Low Crawl
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, crouching. Proof: a ceiling at chest height for forty metres; a lamp-hook every ten.

objects.label: Crawlers ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: Crouch: stamina drains while crouched here (an idea)
The Silent Room
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, at the end of his rope. Proof: no sound at all; a chair, a table, a cup, a note under the cup.

objects.label: SILENCE: no music, no echo; one readable (Noah)
The Nest
objects.notes: Who: the things that came up. Proof: a cluster of folded husks like dead insects, grey cloth in strips.

objects.label: Crawlers ×5
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: Crawler, large (a young altar thing) ×1
objects.notes: tough

objects.label: The Hunger Pit
objects.notes: Who: no one; something ate here. Proof: a pit lined with gnawed bone, a ramp to the east door of the Slot Chamber.

objects.label: Crawlers ×4
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Hushed ×2
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Tool Cache
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, equipping. Proof: picks, shovels, ropes, wedges; a slayer's pack, empty.

objects.label: Crawlers ×2
objects.notes: weak

objects.label: The Long Dark
objects.notes: Who: no one; no lamp burns here. Proof: black stone walls, no torch-hooks; only the Lantern shows the way.

objects.label: Crawlers ×3
objects.notes: standard

objects.label: The Last Bed
objects.notes: Who: the slayer, the night before he went through. Proof: a bed, made; a shackle on the post (open); a cup, upside down. A bed anyone can sleep in.

objects.label: The Last Bed: sleep to rest and save before the door
A last refill: bread, water, a restoring draught
The Slot Chamber
objects.notes: Who: the one who sleeps below. Proof: a round chamber, four sockets in the wall the shape of the stones, empty; the door to him in the south wall. The chains from above end in rings here.

objects.label: Four sockets, the shape of the stones: empty. The door to the beast (0.70 starts here)

Hold up the four stones: they hum together
